capabilities: Insert {{hrcal: references that render day-event cards or inline event chips
Show an agenda list in the sidebar and a month grid in a workspace tab
Configure multiple CalDAV server accounts with per-calendar colors
Expand RRULE/EXDATE recurring events into occurrences
Warn about stale references after account or calendar renames
disambiguation: It is read-only: it never creates, edits, or deletes events on the CalDAV server, it only displays them.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later; the plugin is read-only by design. Full documentation lives in a separate guide (English and Korean); unreviewed per the manifest note.
problem: Obsidian has no way to display events from a CalDAV calendar inside notes or browse them in agenda or month views.

relations.evidence: e.g. Radicale, Nextcloud Calendar, Fastmail, or any RFC 4791 server
